text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Angolan President Jose Eduardo dos Santos said in a brief interview with journalists on Wednesday that a meeting with UNITA leader Jonas Savimbi would only take place if there were assurances that concrete agreements were made by Savimbi.
Dos Santos said previous meetings between the two leaders had led to very little progress.
- Namibian President San Nujoma met dos Santos in a brief stopover in Luanda on Wednesday.
- During the second day of an extraordinary session of the National Assembly, MPLA deputies continued to accuse UNITA on Wednesday of launching a new war.
- Angolan Prime Minister Franca Van-Dunem left on Wednesday to represent the country at the African/African American summit.
